scientific.integrity: The finite claim is reconstructed from the published non-overlapping grain definition and verified by two independent grain-pattern/ball constructions, a complete maximal-clique census, a separate maximum-clique branch search, and an independent ten-clique count.
scientific.limitations: Restricted to binary length 6 and at most two non-overlapping grains. No claim is made for overlapping grains or other parameters. Literature search leaves residual risk of an obscure or unindexed finite enumeration.

title: Exact length-six two-grain codes in the non-overlapping granular channel
